01 / ABOUT

Data Analysis & Business Insights

A statistics foundation combined with practical analytics projects and dashboard development.

I am an entry-level Data Analyst with an MCA and a B.Sc. in Statistics. My project work covers data preparation, exploratory data analysis, SQL querying, KPI reporting, interactive dashboards, and predictive modelling.

I enjoy taking an unstructured dataset, making it reliable, exploring patterns, and communicating the findings in a way that supports decisions. I am seeking an opportunity to contribute these skills while learning from a professional analytics team.
